<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"/>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1a73e8"/>
<title>Kalendarz Pracy</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,"/>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"></script>
<style>
/* === Reset === */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{font-size:14px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}

/* === Tokens — Light === */
:root{
  --blue:#1a73e8;--blue-d:#1557b0;--blue-bg:#e8f0fe;--blue-bg2:#d2e3fc;
  --red:#d93025;--green:#0f9d58;
  --bg:#f6f8fc;--surf:#fff;--surf2:#f1f3f4;--hover:#f1f3f4;
  --txt:#202124;--txt2:#5f6368;--txt3:#80868b;--txtd:#bdc1c6;
  --bdr:#dadce0;--bdr2:#bdc1c6;
  --sh1:0 1px 2px rgba(60,64,67,.3),0 1px 3px rgba(60,64,67,.15);
  --sh2:0 1px 2px rgba(60,64,67,.3),0 2px 6px rgba(60,64,67,.15);
  --sh3:0 4px 8px rgba(60,64,67,.15),0 1px 3px rgba(60,64,67,.3);
  --r4:4px;--r8:8px;--r12:12px;--r50:50px;
  --ff:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
  --tr:.18s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1);
}
/* === Dark === */
[data-theme=dark]{
  --blue:#8ab4f8;--blue-d:#aecbfa;--blue-bg:#1a2540;--blue-bg2:#1e3a5f;
  --red:#f28b82;
  --bg:#202124;--surf:#292a2d;--surf2:#35363a;--hover:#3c4043;
  --txt:#e8eaed;--txt2:#9aa0a6;--txt3:#80868b;--txtd:#5f6368;
  --bdr:#3c4043;--bdr2:#5f6368;
  --sh1:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  --sh2:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  --sh3:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}

/* === App shell === */
body{font-family:var(--ff);background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);
  min-height:100vh;transition:background var(--tr),color var(--tr);overflow-x:hidden}
#app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}

/* === App bar === */
.bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;height:64px;padding:0 16px;
  background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  gap:6px;z-index:10;flex-shrink:0;
  transition:background var(--tr),border-color var(--tr);
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-right:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.brand-ico{
  width:38px;height:38px;background:var(--blue);border-radius:var(--r8);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
  transition:background var(--tr)
}
.brand-ico svg{width:50px;height:20px;fill:#fff}
.brand-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:500;color:var(--txt);white-space:nowrap;
  transition:color var(--tr)}
.brand-name span{color:var(--blue)}

.month-lbl{
  font-size:20px;font-weight:400;color:var(--txt);
  min-width:100px;text-align:center;user-select:none;
  transition:color var(--tr)
}
.spacer{flex:1}

/* Icon button */
.ibtn{
  width:40px;height:40px;border:none;border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;color:var(--txt2);cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background var(--tr);flex-shrink:0
}
.ibtn:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ibtn svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:currentColor}

/* Today button */
.today-btn{
  height:36px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:var(--r50);background:transparent;color:var(--txt);
  font-family:var(--ff);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr);white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0
}
.today-btn:hover{background:var(--hover);box-shadow:var(--sh1)}

/* Theme toggle */
.theme-btn{position:relative}
.theme-btn .ico-moon,.theme-btn .ico-sun{
  position:absolute;transition:opacity var(--tr),transform var(--tr)
}
.theme-btn .ico-moon{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.theme-btn .ico-sun{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-90deg) scale(.6)}
[data-theme=dark] .theme-btn .ico-moon{opacity:0;transform:rotate(90deg) scale(.6)}
[data-theme=dark] .theme-btn .ico-sun{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}

.spacer{flex:1}
/* User chip */
.user-chip{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:4px 4px 4px 12px;
  border:1px solid var(--bdr);<!--border-radius:var(--r50)-->;
  background:var(--surf);transition:background var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr);
  flex-shrink:0
}
.user-chip:focus-within{box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
.chip-lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--txt2);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.chip-input{
  border:none;background:transparent;font-family:var(--ff);
  font-size:14px;color:var(--txt);outline:none;width:110px;font-weight:500
}
.chip-input::placeholder{color:var(--txt3);font-weight:400}
.avatar{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
  transition:background var(--tr)
}

/* === Mobile sub-bar (user + controls) === */
.mobile-subbar{
  display:none;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;
  background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  flex-shrink:0;z-index:9;
  transition:background var(--tr),border-color var(--tr)
}
.mobile-subbar .chip-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--txt2);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.mobile-subbar .chip-input{
  border:none;background:transparent;font-family:var(--ff);
  font-size:13px;color:var(--txt);outline:none;min-width:0;flex:1;font-weight:500
}
.mobile-subbar .chip-input::placeholder{color:var(--txt3);font-weight:400}
.mobile-subbar .avatar{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
  transition:background var(--tr)
}
.mobile-subbar .ibtn{
  width:36px;height:36px;border:none;border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;color:var(--txt2);cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background var(--tr);flex-shrink:0
}
.mobile-subbar .ibtn:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.mobile-subbar .ibtn svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:currentColor}
.mobile-subbar .user-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:1;min-width:0;
  padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:var(--r50);
  background:var(--surf2);
}
.mobile-subbar .divider{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--bdr);flex-shrink:0}
/* Dark mode icons for mobile sub-bar */
.mobile-subbar .theme-btn{position:relative}
.mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-moon,.mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-sun{
  position:absolute;transition:opacity var(--tr),transform var(--tr)
}
.mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-moon{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-sun{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-90deg) scale(.6)}
[data-theme=dark] .mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-moon{opacity:0;transform:rotate(90deg) scale(.6)}
[data-theme=dark] .mobile-subbar .theme-btn .ico-sun{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}

/* === Range bar === */
.range-bar{
  display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;
  background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;
  flex-shrink:0
}
.range-bar.on{display:flex}
.range-bar svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.range-cancel{
  margin-left:auto;padding:4px 12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  border-radius:var(--r50);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer
}
.range-cancel:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}

/* === Stats bar === */
.stats{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;
  background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  transition:background var(--tr),border-color var(--tr)
}
.stats::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.stat{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 12px;
  background:var(--surf2);border-radius:var(--r50);white-space:nowrap;
  transition:background var(--tr)
}
.stat-ico{width:15px;height:15px;fill:var(--blue);flex-shrink:0}
.stat-lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--txt2)}
.stat-val{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt);transition:color var(--tr)}
.stat-val.a{color:var(--blue)}
.sdiv{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--bdr);flex-shrink:0}

/* === Calendar === */
.cal-wrap{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.wday-hdr{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);
  background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  flex-shrink:0;transition:background var(--tr),border-color var(--tr)
}
.wday{
  text-align:center;padding:9px 4px;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt2);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px
}
.wday.wknd{color:var(--red)}

.grid{
  flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);
  overflow-y:auto;align-content:start;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--bdr2) transparent
}
.grid::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
.grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bdr2);border-radius:3px}

/* Day cell */
.cell{
  border-right:1px solid var(--bdr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  min-height:96px;padding:5px 3px 3px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--surf);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:background var(--tr),border-color var(--tr);user-select:none
}
.cell:nth-child(7n){border-right:none}
.cell:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.cell.other{background:var(--bg)}
.cell.other .dnum{color:var(--txtd)}
.cell.wknd:not(.other){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surf) 96%,var(--red) 4%)}
[data-theme=dark] .cell.wknd:not(.other){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surf) 94%,var(--red) 6%)}

/* Range highlight */
.cell.in-rng{background:var(--blue-bg)!important}
.cell.rng-s{border-radius:10px 0 0 10px}
.cell.rng-e{border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}

/* Day number */
.dnum-w{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:3px}
.dnum{
  width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--txt);
  transition:background var(--tr),color var(--tr)
}
.cell.wknd:not(.other) .dnum{color:var(--red)}
.cell.hday:not(.other) .dnum{color:var(--red)}
.cell.today .dnum{background:var(--blue);color:#fff!important;font-weight:700;
  box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(26,115,232,.35)}

/* Holiday label */
.hbadge{
  font-size:9px;color:var(--red);text-align:center;
  line-height:1.2;margin:0 2px 2px;
  overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-weight:600
}

/* Work tile */
.tile{
  margin:2px 2px 0;
  background:var(--blue-bg);border-left:3px solid var(--blue);
  border-radius:0 var(--r4) var(--r4) 0;
  padding:3px 4px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;
  transition:background var(--tr),transform var(--tr);cursor:pointer
}
.tile:hover{transform:translateX(1px)}
.tile .ts{font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-d);white-space:nowrap}
.tile .te{font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-d);white-space:nowrap}
.tile .th{font-weight:500;color:var(--blue)}
[data-theme=dark] .tile{background:var(--blue-bg2)}
[data-theme=dark] .tile .ts,[data-theme=dark] .tile .te{color:var(--blue)}

/* === FAB === */
.fab{
  position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:20px;
  width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;
  background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:var(--sh3);z-index:50;
  transition:background var(--tr),transform var(--tr)
}
.fab:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.fab svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:#fff}

/* === Modal === */
.backdrop{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:16px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
  transition:opacity var(--tr),visibility var(--tr);
  backdrop-filter:blur(2px)
}
.backdrop.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.modal{
  background:var(--surf);border-radius:var(--r12);
  box-shadow:var(--sh3);width:100%;max-width:400px;overflow:hidden;
  transform:scale(.94) translateY(8px);
  transition:transform var(--tr),background var(--tr)
}
.backdrop.open .modal{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}

.mhdr{padding:20px 24px 0}
.mtitle{font-size:20px;font-weight:500;color:var(--txt);margin-bottom:4px}
.mdate{font-size:13px;color:var(--txt2);margin-bottom:2px}
.hpill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  background:#fce8e6;color:var(--red);
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 10px;
  border-radius:var(--r50);margin-top:6px
}
[data-theme=dark] .hpill{background:#4a1c1a}
.rpill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  background:var(--blue-bg);color:var(--blue);
  font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 10px;
  border-radius:var(--r50);margin-top:6px
}

.mbody{padding:16px 24px}
.flbl{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt2);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.trow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.tsep{color:var(--txt2);font-weight:500;font-size:18px;text-align:center}
.twrap{position:relative}
.twrap svg{position:absolute;left:9px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:16px;height:16px;fill:var(--txt2);pointer-events:none}
.tinput{
  width:100%;padding:10px 10px 10px 32px;
  border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:var(--r8);
  background:var(--surf2);color:var(--txt);
  font-family:var(--ff);font-size:16px;font-weight:500;outline:none;
  transition:border-color var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr),background var(--tr);
  -webkit-appearance:none
}
.tinput:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,115,232,.2);background:var(--surf)}

.preview{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;
  background:var(--surf2);border-radius:var(--r8);margin-top:12px;
  transition:background var(--tr)
}
.preview svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:var(--blue);flex-shrink:0}
.ptxt{font-size:14px;color:var(--txt2)}
.ptxt strong{color:var(--blue);font-size:16px}
.ptxt.err strong{color:var(--red)}

.mdiv{height:1px;background:var(--bdr);transition:background var(--tr)}
.mfoot{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:12px 24px 16px;gap:8px}
.mfoot-sp{flex:1}

/* Buttons */
.btn{
  height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:var(--r50);
  font-family:var(--ff);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;
  cursor:pointer;border:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  transition:background var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr);white-space:nowrap
}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:currentColor}
.btn-txt{background:transparent;color:var(--blue)}
.btn-txt:hover{background:var(--blue-bg)}
.btn-fill{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh1)}
.btn-fill:hover{background:var(--blue-d);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.btn-del{background:transparent;color:var(--red)}
.btn-del:hover{background:#fce8e6}
[data-theme=dark] .btn-del:hover{background:#4a1c1a}

/* === Multi-select mode === */
.cell.sel{
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue-bg) 80%,var(--blue) 20%)!important;
  outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:-2px;
}
.cell.sel .dnum{background:var(--blue);color:#fff!important;font-weight:700}

/* Selection toolbar */
.sel-bar{
  display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;
  background:#1e3a5f;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;
  flex-shrink:0;z-index:9;
}
[data-theme=light] .sel-bar{background:#1557b0}
.sel-bar.on{display:flex}
.sel-bar svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.sel-count{flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.sel-btn{
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:var(--r50);border:none;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:var(--ff);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;transition:background .15s
}
.sel-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:currentColor}
.sel-del{background:#e53935;color:#fff}
.sel-del:hover{background:#c62828}
.sel-fill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.sel-fill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.sel-cancel{background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.sel-cancel:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}

/* Screenshot & clear buttons use standard .ibtn style */
/* Select mode button active state */
.ibtn.sel-active{background:var(--blue-bg);color:var(--blue)}
[data-theme=dark] .ibtn.sel-active{background:var(--blue-bg2)}
.snack{
  position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);
  background:#323232;color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;
  border-radius:var(--r8);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;
  box-shadow:var(--sh3);z-index:200;
  transition:transform var(--tr);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none
}
.snack.on{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

/* === Responsive === */
@media(max-width:768px){
  .bar{height:52px;padding:0 8px;gap:3px}
  .brand-name{display:none}
  .user-chip{display:none}
  .bar #rangeBtn,.bar #themeBtn{display:none}
  .mobile-subbar{display:flex}
  .month-lbl{font-size:17px;min-width:120px}
  .fab{display:flex}
  .stats{padding:6px 10px;gap:5px}
  .stat{padding:4px 9px}
  .stat-lbl{display:none}
  .cell{min-height:80px;padding:4px 3px 3px}
  .dnum{width:24px;height:24px;font-size:11px}
  .tile{font-size:9px;padding:3px 4px;margin:2px 2px 0;line-height:1.5}
  .tile .ts,.tile .te{font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap}
  .tile .th{display:none}
  .sel-bar{padding:6px 10px;gap:6px}
  .sel-btn{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px}
  .modal{max-width:100%;border-radius:var(--r12) var(--r12) 0 0}
  .backdrop{align-items:flex-end;padding:0}
  .sdiv{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .cell{min-height:72px}
  .hbadge{display:none}
  .today-btn{padding:0 10px;font-size:12px}
  .tile .ts,.tile .te{font-size:8px}
}
@media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse){
  .cell:hover{background:var(--surf)}
  .cell.wknd:not(.other):hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surf) 96%,var(--red) 4%)}
  .cell.in-rng:hover{background:var(--blue-bg)!important}
}
@media print{
  .bar,.stats,.backdrop,.fab,.range-bar,.sel-bar,.snack{display:none!important}
  .grid{overflow:visible}
  body{background:#fff}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">

<!-- App bar -->
<header class="bar">
  <div class="brand">
    <div class="brand-ico">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 3h-1V1h-2v2H8V1H6v2H5C3.89 3 3 3.89 3 5v14c0 1.1.89 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.11-.89-2-2-2zm0 16H5V8h14v11zM7 10h5v5H7z"/></svg>
    </div>
    <span class="brand-name">Kalendarz <span>Pracy</span></span>
  </div>

  <button class="today-btn" id="todayBtn">Dziś</button>
  <button class="ibtn" id="prevBtn" aria-label="Poprzedni miesiąc">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15.41 7.41L14 6l-6 6 6 6 1.41-1.41L10.83 12z"/></svg>
  </button>
  <div class="month-lbl" id="monthLbl"></div>
  <button class="ibtn" id="nextBtn" aria-label="Następny miesiąc">

<!-- Snackbar -->
<div class="snack" id="snack"></div>

<script>
'use strict';
// ─── Polish Holidays ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PH = (() => {
  const cache = {};
  function easter(y) {
    const a=y%19,b=Math.floor(y/100),c=y%100,d=Math.floor(b/4),e=b%4,
      f=Math.floor((b+8)/25),g=Math.floor((b-f+1)/3),
      h=(19*a+b-d-g+15)%30,i=Math.floor(c/4),k=c%4,
      l=(32+2*e+2*i-h-k)%7,m=Math.floor((a+11*h+22*l)/451),
      mo=Math.floor((h+l-7*m+114)/31),da=((h+l-7*m+114)%31)+1;
    return new Date(y,mo-1,da);
  }
  function add(d,n){const r=new Date(d);r.setDate(r.getDate()+n);return r}
  function fmt(d){return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth()+1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`}
  function get(y){
    if(cache[y])return cache[y];
    const e=easter(y),h={};
    [[`${y}-01-01`,'Nowy Rok'],[`${y}-01-06`,'Trzech Króli'],
     [`${y}-05-01`,'Święto Pracy'],[`${y}-05-03`,'Konstytucja 3 Maja'],
     [`${y}-08-15`,'Wniebowzięcie NMP'],[`${y}-11-01`,'Wszystkich Świętych'],
     [`${y}-11-11`,'Święto Niepodległości'],[`${y}-12-25`,'Boże Narodzenie'],
     [`${y}-12-26`,'Drugi dzień Bożego Narodzenia'],
     [fmt(e),'Wielkanoc'],[fmt(add(e,1)),'Poniedziałek Wielkanocny'],
     [fmt(add(e,49)),'Zielone Świątki'],[fmt(add(e,60)),'Boże Ciało']
    ].forEach(([dt,n])=>h[dt]=n);
    cache[y]=h;return h;
  }
  return{name:s=>get(+s.slice(0,4))[s]||null,is:s=>!!get(+s.slice(0,4))[s]};
})();

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const MO=['Styczeń','Luty','Marzec','Kwiecień','Maj','Czerwiec',
          'Lipiec','Sierpień','Wrzesień','Październik','Listopad','Grudzień'];
const MG=['stycznia','lutego','marca','kwietnia','maja','czerwca',
          'lipca','sierpnia','września','października','listopada','grudnia'];
const DW=['Niedziela','Poniedziałek','Wtorek','Środa','Czwartek','Piątek','Sobota'];
const SK='wc_data2', TK='wc_theme', UK='wc_user';

// ─── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let Y=new Date().getFullYear(), M=new Date().getMonth();
let data={}, theme='light', user='';
let rMode=false, rS=null, rE=null;
let selMode=false, selDays=new Set(), mSelDays=new Set();
let mOpen=false, mDate=null, mIsRange=false, mRS=null, mRE=null;

function p(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0')}
function dk(y,m,d){return `${y}-${p(m+1)}-${p(d)}`}
function pd(s){const[y,m,d]=s.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d)}
function cmp(a,b){return pd(a)-pd(b)}

function range(s,e){
  const[a,b]=cmp(s,e)<=0?[s,e]:[e,s];
  const out=[],cur=pd(a),end=pd(b);
  while(cur<=end){
    out.push(`${cur.getFullYear()}-${p(cur.getMonth()+1)}-${p(cur.getDate())}`);
    cur.setDate(cur.getDate()+1);
  }
  return out;
}

function hrs(s,e){
  if(!s||!e)return 0;
  const[sh,sm]=s.split(':').map(Number),[eh,em]=e.split(':').map(Number);
  const d=(eh*60+em)-(sh*60+sm);return d>0?d/60:0;
}

function fh(h){
  if(h<=0)return'0 h';
  const hh=Math.floor(h),mm=Math.round((h-hh)*60);
  return mm?`${hh} h ${mm} min`:`${hh} h`;
}

// ─── Storage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function load(){
  try{const r=localStorage.getItem(SK);if(r)data=JSON.parse(r);}catch(e){data={}}
  theme=localStorage.getItem(TK)||'light';
  user=localStorage.getItem(UK)||'';
}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(SK,JSON.stringify(data));}catch(e){}}
function saveTh(){try{localStorage.setItem(TK,theme);}catch(e){}}
function saveU(){try{localStorage.setItem(UK,user);}catch(e){}}

// ─── Theme ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function applyTheme(){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',theme)}
function toggleTheme(){theme=theme==='light'?'dark':'light';applyTheme();saveTh()}

// ─── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function initials(n){
  if(!n.trim())return'?';
  return n.trim().split(/\s+/).map(w=>w[0].toUpperCase()).slice(0,2).join('');
}

function stats(){
  const dim=new Date(Y,M+1,0).getDate();
  let tot=0,wd=0,ed=0;
  for(let d=1;d<=dim;d++){
    const s=dk(Y,M,d),dt=new Date(Y,M,d),dw=dt.getDay();
    if(dw!==0&&dw!==6&&!PH.is(s))wd++;
    const e=data[s];if(e){tot+=hrs(e.s,e.e);ed++;}
  }
  document.getElementById('sTotal').textContent=fh(tot);
  document.getElementById('sWork').textContent=wd;
  document.getElementById('sEntry').textContent=ed;
  document.getElementById('sAvg').textContent=ed>0?fh(tot/ed):'—';
}

function render(){
  document.getElementById('monthLbl').textContent=`${MO[M]} ${Y}`;
  renderGrid();
  stats();
  document.getElementById('avatar').textContent=initials(user);
  document.getElementById('avatarMobile').textContent=initials(user);
}

function renderGrid(){
  const g=document.getElementById('grid');
  g.innerHTML='';
  const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  let sd=new Date(Y,M,1).getDay();
  sd=sd===0?6:sd-1;
  const dim=new Date(Y,M+1,0).getDate();
  const pd0=new Date(Y,M,0).getDate();
  const cells=Math.ceil((sd+dim)/7)*7;

  // range bounds
  let rs=rS,re=rE||rS;
  if(rs&&re&&cmp(rs,re)>0){[rs,re]=[re,rs]}

  for(let i=0;i<cells;i++){
    let day,mo,yr,cur=true;
    if(i<sd){day=pd0-sd+i+1;mo=M-1;yr=Y;if(mo<0){mo=11;yr--;}cur=false;}
    else if(i>=sd+dim){day=i-sd-dim+1;mo=M+1;yr=Y;if(mo>11){mo=0;yr++;}cur=false;}
    else{day=i-sd+1;mo=M;yr=Y;}

    const ds=dk(yr,mo,day);
    const dt=new Date(yr,mo,day);
    const dw=dt.getDay();
    const isWk=dw===0||dw===6;
    const isH=PH.is(ds);
    const isTd=ds===today;
    const entry=data[ds];

    const c=document.createElement('div');
    c.className='cell';
    if(!cur)c.classList.add('other');
    if(isWk)c.classList.add('wknd');
    if(isH&&cur)c.classList.add('hday');
    if(isTd)c.classList.add('today');

    // range
    if(rs&&re&&ds>=rs&&ds<=re){
      c.classList.add('in-rng');
      if(ds===rs)c.classList.add('rng-s');
      if(ds===re)c.classList.add('rng-e');
    }

    if(selMode&&selDays.has(ds))c.classList.add('sel');

    // day number
    const nw=document.createElement('div');nw.className='dnum-w';
    const ne=document.createElement('div');ne.className='dnum';
    ne.textContent=day;nw.appendChild(ne);c.appendChild(nw);

    // holiday
    if(isH&&cur){
      const hb=document.createElement('div');hb.className='hbadge';
      hb.textContent=PH.name(ds);c.appendChild(hb);
    }

    // tile
    if(entry){
      const h=hrs(entry.s,entry.e);
      const t=document.createElement('div');t.className='tile';
      t.innerHTML=`<div class="ts">${entry.s}</div><div class="te">${entry.e}</div><div class="th">${fh(h)}</div>`;
      c.appendChild(t);
    }

    c.addEventListener('click',()=>cellClick(ds,day,mo,yr));

    // Right-click on tile: quick delete
    c.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{
      if(data[ds]){e.preventDefault();if(confirm(`Usunąć wpis dla ${ds}?`)){delete data[ds];save();render();snack('Usunięto wpis');}}
    });

    // Long-press on tile: quick delete (mobile)
    let lpTimer;
    c.addEventListener('touchstart',()=>{
      lpTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
        if(data[ds]){if(confirm(`Usunąć wpis dla ${ds}?`)){delete data[ds];save();render();snack('Usunięto wpis');}}
      },600);
    },{passive:true});
    c.addEventListener('touchend',()=>clearTimeout(lpTimer),{passive:true});
    c.addEventListener('touchmove',()=>clearTimeout(lpTimer),{passive:true});

    c.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{
      if(rMode&&rS&&!rE){rE=ds;renderGrid();}
    });
    c.addEventListener('touchstart',()=>{
      if(rMode&&rS&&!rE){rE=ds;renderGrid();}
    },{passive:true});
    g.appendChild(c);
  }
}

// ─── Range mode ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function cellClick(ds,day,mo,yr){
  if(selMode){
    if(selDays.has(ds))selDays.delete(ds);
    else selDays.add(ds);
    updateSelBar();
    renderGrid();
    return;
  }
  if(rMode){
    if(!rS){rS=ds;rE=null;
      document.getElementById('rangeTip').textContent='Kliknij dzień końcowy';
      renderGrid();
    } else {
      rE=ds;renderGrid();
      const[a,b]=cmp(rS,rE)<=0?[rS,rE]:[rE,rS];
      openModal(ds,day,mo,yr,true,a,b);
    }
    return;
  }
  openModal(ds,day,mo,yr,false,null,null);
}

function toggleRange(){
  rMode=!rMode;rS=null;rE=null;
  const bar=document.getElementById('rangeBar');
  if(rMode){bar.classList.add('on');
    document.getElementById('rangeTip').textContent='Kliknij dzień startowy, następnie dzień końcowy';
  } else {bar.classList.remove('on');}
  renderGrid();
}

function cancelRange(){
  rMode=false;rS=null;rE=null;
  document.getElementById('rangeBar').classList.remove('on');
  renderGrid();
}

// ─── Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function openModal(ds,day,mo,yr,isRange,rs,re){
  mDate=ds;mIsRange=isRange;mRS=rs;mRE=re;mOpen=true;

  const dw=new Date(yr,mo,day).getDay();
  const hname=PH.name(ds);

  if(isRange&&rs&&re){
    document.getElementById('mTitle').textContent='Dodaj godziny — zakres';
    const sd2=pd(rs),ed2=pd(re);
    document.getElementById('mDate').textContent=
      `${sd2.getDate()} ${MG[sd2.getMonth()]} – ${ed2.getDate()} ${MG[ed2.getMonth()]} ${ed2.getFullYear()}`;
    const cnt=range(rs,re).length;
    const rp=document.getElementById('mRange');
    rp.textContent=`${cnt} dni`;rp.style.display='inline-flex';
    document.getElementById('delBtn').style.display='none';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('mTitle').textContent='Godziny pracy';
    document.getElementById('mDate').textContent=
      `${DW[dw]}, ${day} ${MG[mo]} ${yr}`;
    document.getElementById('mRange').style.display='none';
    const entry=data[ds];
    document.getElementById('delBtn').style.display=entry?'flex':'none';
  }

  const hp=document.getElementById('mHoliday');
  if(hname){hp.textContent='★ '+hname;hp.style.display='inline-flex';}
  else hp.style.display='none';

  const entry=data[ds];
  document.getElementById('tStart').value=entry?entry.s:'08:00';
  document.getElementById('tEnd').value=entry?entry.e:'16:00';
  updatePreview();
  document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('tStart').focus(),50);
}

function closeModal(){
  document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.remove('open');
  mOpen=false;mSelDays.clear();
  if(rMode){rS=null;rE=null;
    document.getElementById('rangeTip').textContent='Kliknij dzień startowy, następnie dzień końcowy';
    renderGrid();
  }
}

function updatePreview(){
  const s=document.getElementById('tStart').value;
  const e=document.getElementById('tEnd').value;
  const h=hrs(s,e);
  const pv=document.getElementById('preview');
  const ico='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="width:18px;height:18px;fill:var(--blue);flex-shrink:0"><path d="M11.99 2C6.47 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.47 10 9.99 10C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12S17.52 2 11.99 2zM12 20c-4.42 0-8-3.58-8-8s3.58-8 8-8 8 3.58 8 8-3.58 8-8 8zm.5-13H11v6l5.25 3.15.75-1.23-4.5-2.67V7z"/></svg>';
  if(h<=0){pv.innerHTML=ico+'<span class="ptxt err">Czas końcowy musi być późniejszy</span>';}
  else{pv.innerHTML=ico+`<span class="ptxt">Czas pracy: <strong>${fh(h)}</strong></span>`;}
}

function doSave(){
  const s=document.getElementById('tStart').value;
  const e=document.getElementById('tEnd').value;
  if(hrs(s,e)<=0)return;
  if(mSelDays.size>0){
    const n=mSelDays.size;
    mSelDays.forEach(d=>data[d]={s,e});
    mSelDays.clear();
    snack(`Zapisano ${n} ${n===1?'dzień':'dni'}`);
    save();closeModal();cancelSel();render();
  } else if(mIsRange&&mRS&&mRE){
    const dates=range(mRS,mRE);
    dates.forEach(d=>data[d]={s,e});
    snack(`Zapisano ${dates.length} dni`);
    save();closeModal();cancelRange();render();
  } else {
    data[mDate]={s,e};snack('Zapisano');
    save();closeModal();render();
  }
}

function doDelete(){
  delete data[mDate];save();closeModal();render();snack('Usunięto wpis');
}

// ─── Multi-select ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function toggleSelMode(){
  selMode=!selMode;selDays.clear();
  document.getElementById('selectBtn').classList.toggle('sel-active',selMode);
  document.getElementById('selectBtnMobile').classList.toggle('sel-active',selMode);
  updateSelBar();renderGrid();
}
function cancelSel(){
  selMode=false;selDays.clear();
  document.getElementById('selectBtn').classList.remove('sel-active');
  document.getElementById('selectBtnMobile').classList.remove('sel-active');
  document.getElementById('selBar').classList.remove('on');
  renderGrid();
}
function updateSelBar(){
  const n=selDays.size;
  const bar=document.getElementById('selBar');
  bar.classList.toggle('on',selMode);
  document.getElementById('selCount').textContent=
    n===0?'Kliknij dni aby zaznaczyć':`${n} ${n===1?'dzień':'dni'} zaznaczonych`;
  document.getElementById('selDelBtn').style.display=n>0?'flex':'none';
  document.getElementById('selFillBtn').style.display=n>0?'flex':'none';
}
function selDelete(){
  if(selDays.size===0)return;
  const n=selDays.size;
  if(!confirm(`Usunąć wpisy z ${n} ${n===1?'dnia':'dni'}?`))return;
  selDays.forEach(d=>delete data[d]);
  save();snack(`Usunięto wpisy z ${n} ${n===1?'dnia':'dni'}`);
  cancelSel();render();
}
function selFill(){
  if(selDays.size===0)return;
  const sorted=[...selDays].sort();
  mDate=sorted[0];mIsRange=false;mRS=null;mRE=null;
  // Open modal in "multi-sel" mode
  mSelDays=new Set(selDays);
  const n=sorted.length;
  document.getElementById('mTitle').textContent='Dodaj godziny — wybrane dni';
  document.getElementById('mDate').textContent=`${n} ${n===1?'dzień':'dni'} zaznaczonych`;
  document.getElementById('mRange').textContent=`${n} dni`;
  document.getElementById('mRange').style.display='inline-flex';
  document.getElementById('mHoliday').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('delBtn').style.display='none';
  const entry=data[sorted[0]];
  document.getElementById('tStart').value=entry?entry.s:'08:00';
  document.getElementById('tEnd').value=entry?entry.e:'16:00';
  updatePreview();mOpen=true;
  document.getElementById('backdrop').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('tStart').focus(),50);
}

// ─── Clear month ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function clearMonth(){
  const dim=new Date(Y,M+1,0).getDate();
  const keys=[];
  for(let d=1;d<=dim;d++){const k=dk(Y,M,d);if(data[k])keys.push(k);}
  if(keys.length===0){snack('Brak wpisów w tym miesiącu');return;}
  if(!confirm(`Usunąć wszystkie wpisy z miesiąca ${MO[M]} ${Y}? (${keys.length} ${keys.length===1?'dzień':'dni'})`))return;
  keys.forEach(k=>delete data[k]);
  save();render();snack(`Wyczyszczono ${keys.length} ${keys.length===1?'wpis':'wpisów'}`);
}

// ─── Screenshot (native canvas renderer) ─────────────────────────────────────
function takeScreenshot(){
  document.getElementById('screenshotBtn').disabled=true;
  document.getElementById('screenshotBtnMobile').disabled=true;
  snack('Generowanie zrzutu…');
  setTimeout(_renderScreenshot, 80);
}

function _renderScreenshot(){
  try{
  const isDark = theme==='dark';
  const C = isDark ? {
    bg:'#202124',surf:'#292a2d',surf2:'#35363a',
    txt:'#e8eaed',txt2:'#9aa0a6',txtd:'#5f6368',
    bdr:'#3c4043',blue:'#8ab4f8',blueD:'#aecbfa',
    blueBg:'#1a2540',red:'#f28b82',
    wkndBg:'#2e2a2a',todayFill:'#8ab4f8',todayTxt:'#202124'
  }:{
    bg:'#f6f8fc',surf:'#ffffff',surf2:'#f1f3f4',
    txt:'#202124',txt2:'#5f6368',txtd:'#bdc1c6',
    bdr:'#dadce0',blue:'#1a73e8',blueD:'#1557b0',
    blueBg:'#e8f0fe',red:'#d93025',
    wkndBg:'#fef9f9',todayFill:'#1a73e8',todayTxt:'#ffffff'
  };

  const SC=2, W=840;
  const HEADER_H=54, STATS_H=42, WDAY_H=30;
  const COL=7, CW=W/COL;

  const dimDays=new Date(Y,M+1,0).getDate();
  let sd=new Date(Y,M,1).getDay(); sd=sd===0?6:sd-1;
  const cells=Math.ceil((sd+dimDays)/7)*7;
  const ROWS=cells/7, RH=90;
  const H=HEADER_H+STATS_H+WDAY_H+ROWS*RH;

  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width=W*SC; cv.height=H*SC;
  const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.scale(SC,SC);
  const ff="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif";

  // helpers
  const fr=(x,y,w,h,fill,r=0)=>{
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(r&&ctx.roundRect){ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);}
    else{ctx.rect(x,y,w,h);}
    ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();
  };
  const ft=(s,x,y,col,sz,wt='normal',al='left')=>{
    ctx.font=`${wt} ${sz}px ${ff}`;
    ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.textAlign=al;ctx.fillText(s,x,y);
  };
  const fl=(x1,y1,x2,y2,col,lw=0.5)=>{
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);
    ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.stroke();
  };

  // ── Header ──
  fr(0,0,W,HEADER_H,C.surf);
  fl(0,HEADER_H,W,HEADER_H,C.bdr,1);
  fr(14,10,34,34,C.blue,8);
  ft('Kalendarz ',56,32,C.txt,16,'500');
  const kw=ctx.measureText('Kalendarz ').width;
  ft('Pracy',56+kw,32,C.blue,16,'500');
  ft(`${MO[M]} ${Y}`,W/2,33,C.txt,17,'400','center');
  if(user) ft(user,W-14,32,C.txt2,12,'500','right');

  // ── Stats ──
  const SY=HEADER_H;
  fr(0,SY,W,STATS_H,C.surf);
  fl(0,SY+STATS_H,W,SY+STATS_H,C.bdr,1);
  let tot=0,wd=0,ed=0;
  for(let d=1;d<=dimDays;d++){
    const s=dk(Y,M,d),dw2=new Date(Y,M,d).getDay();
    if(dw2!==0&&dw2!==6&&!PH.is(s))wd++;
    const e=data[s];if(e){tot+=hrs(e.s,e.e);ed++;}
  }
  const sl=[
    {l:'Przepracowane:',v:fh(tot),vc:C.blue},
    {l:'Dni robocze:',v:String(wd),vc:C.txt},
    {l:'Dni z wpisami:',v:String(ed),vc:C.txt},
    {l:'Śr/dzień:',v:ed>0?fh(tot/ed):'—',vc:C.txt},
  ];
  let sx=16;
  sl.forEach((s,i)=>{
    if(i>0){fl(sx,SY+8,sx,SY+STATS_H-8,C.bdr,1);sx+=12;}
    ctx.font=`500 10px ${ff}`;ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillStyle=C.txt2;
    ctx.fillText(s.l,sx,SY+26);
    const lw2=ctx.measureText(s.l).width;
    ctx.font=`600 12px ${ff}`;ctx.fillStyle=s.vc;
    ctx.fillText(s.v,sx+lw2+4,SY+26);
    sx+=lw2+4+ctx.measureText(s.v).width+14;
  });

  // ── Weekday header ──
  const WY=SY+STATS_H;
  fr(0,WY,W,WDAY_H,C.surf);
  fl(0,WY+WDAY_H,W,WY+WDAY_H,C.bdr,1);
  ['Pon','Wt','Śr','Czw','Pt','Sob','Nd'].forEach((d,i)=>{
    ft(d,i*CW+CW/2,WY+20,i>=5?C.red:C.txt2,9,'600','center');
  });

  // ── Grid ──
  const GY=WY+WDAY_H;
  const today2=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const pd0=new Date(Y,M,0).getDate();

  for(let i=0;i<cells;i++){
    let day,mo,yr,cur=true;
    if(i<sd){day=pd0-sd+i+1;mo=M-1;yr=Y;if(mo<0){mo=11;yr--;}cur=false;}
    else if(i>=sd+dimDays){day=i-sd-dimDays+1;mo=M+1;yr=Y;if(mo>11){mo=0;yr++;}cur=false;}
    else{day=i-sd+1;mo=M;yr=Y;}

    const ds=dk(yr,mo,day);
    const dtObj=new Date(yr,mo,day),dw=dtObj.getDay();
    const isWk=dw===0||dw===6,isH=PH.is(ds)&&cur,isTd=ds===today2;
    const entry=data[ds];

    const cx=(i%7)*CW, cy=GY+Math.floor(i/7)*RH;

    // bg
    let bg=cur?C.surf:C.bg;
    if(cur&&isWk)bg=C.wkndBg;
    fr(cx,cy,CW,RH,bg);
    fl(cx+CW,cy,cx+CW,cy+RH,C.bdr);
    fl(cx,cy+RH,cx+CW,cy+RH,C.bdr);

    // day number
    const dnx=cx+CW/2, dny=cy+18;
    if(isTd){
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(dnx,dny-4,11,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle=C.todayFill;ctx.fill();
      ft(String(day),dnx,dny+3,C.todayTxt,10,'700','center');
    } else {
      const dc=!cur?C.txtd:(isWk||isH)?C.red:C.txt;
      ft(String(day),dnx,dny+3,dc,10,'400','center');
    }

    // holiday
    if(isH){
      const hn=PH.name(ds);
      if(hn){
        const sh=hn.length>15?hn.slice(0,13)+'…':hn;
        ft(sh,cx+CW/2,cy+33,C.red,7,'600','center');
      }
    }

    // work tile
    if(entry){
      const tileY=cy+(isH?38:29);
      const tileH=RH-(tileY-cy)-4;
      fr(cx+3,tileY,CW-6,Math.max(tileH,24),C.blueBg,3);
      fr(cx+3,tileY,3,Math.max(tileH,24),C.blue,3);
      ft(entry.s,cx+9,tileY+12,C.blueD,8,'700','left');
      ft(entry.e,cx+9,tileY+23,C.blueD,8,'700','left');
    }
  }

  // ── Save ──
  const now=new Date();
  const fname=`kalendarz_${now.getFullYear()}${p(now.getMonth()+1)}${p(now.getDate())}_${p(now.getHours())}${p(now.getMinutes())}.jpg`;
  cv.toBlob(blob=>{
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url;a.download=fname;
    document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
    setTimeout(()=>{document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);},1000);
    snack('Zapisano: '+fname);
  },'image/jpeg',0.93);
  }catch(err){snack('Błąd: '+err.message);}
  finally{
    document.getElementById('screenshotBtn').disabled=false;
    document.getElementById('screenshotBtnMobile').disabled=false;
  }
}

// ─── Nav ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function nav(d){
  M+=d;if(M>11){M=0;Y++;}else if(M<0){M=11;Y--;}
  rS=null;rE=null;render();
}

// ─── Snackbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let st;
function snack(msg){
  const el=document.getElementById('snack');el.textContent=msg;
  el.classList.add('on');clearTimeout(st);
  st=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('on'),2500);
}

// ─── Keyboard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(mOpen){
    if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal();
    if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey&&e.target.tagName!=='BUTTON')doSave();
    return;
  }
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')nav(-1);
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')nav(1);
  if(e.key==='t'||e.key==='T'){const n=new Date();Y=n.getFullYear();M=n.getMonth();render();}
  if(e.key==='d'||e.key==='D')toggleTheme();
  if(e.key==='r'||e.key==='R')toggleRange();
  if(e.key==='x'||e.key==='X')toggleSelMode();
  if(e.key==='s'||e.key==='S')takeScreenshot();
});

// ─── Swipe ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let tx=0;
document.getElementById('grid').addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{tx=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
document.getElementById('grid').addEventListener('touchend',e=>{
  const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-tx;
  if(Math.abs(dx)>60)nav(dx<0?1:-1);
},{passive:true});

// ─── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load();applyTheme();

document.getElementById('userInput').value=user;
document.getElementById('userInput').addEventListener('input',e=>{
  user=e.target.value;saveU();
  document.getElementById('avatar').textContent=initials(user);
  document.getElementById('avatarMobile').textContent=initials(user);
  document.getElementById('userInputMobile').value=user;
});

// Mobile sub-bar user input sync
document.getElementById('userInputMobile').value=user;
document.getElementById('userInputMobile').addEventListener('input',e=>{
  user=e.target.value;saveU();
  document.getElementById('avatar').textContent=initials(user);
  document.getElementById('avatarMobile').textContent=initials(user);
  document.getElementById('userInput').value=user;
});

document.getElementById('themeBtn').addEventListener('click',toggleTheme);
document.getElementById('themeBtnMobile').addEventListener('click',toggleTheme);
document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>nav(-1));
document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>nav(1));
document.getElementById('todayBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const n=new Date();Y=n.getFullYear();M=n.getMonth();render();
});
document.getElementById('rangeBtn').addEventListener('click',toggleRange);
document.getElementById('rangeBtnMobile').addEventListener('click',toggleRange);
document.getElementById('rangeCancelBtn').addEventListener('click',cancelRange);
document.getElementById('selectBtn').addEventListener('click',toggleSelMode);
document.getElementById('selectBtnMobile').addEventListener('click',toggleSelMode);
document.getElementById('selCancelBtn').addEventListener('click',cancelSel);
document.getElementById('selDelBtn').addEventListener('click',selDelete);
document.getElementById('selFillBtn').addEventListener('click',selFill);
document.getElementById('clearMonthBtn').addEventListener('click',clearMonth);
document.getElementById('clearMonthBtnMobile').addEventListener('click',clearMonth);
document.getElementById('screenshotBtn').addEventListener('click',takeScreenshot);
document.getElementById('screenshotBtnMobile').addEventListener('click',takeScreenshot);
document.getElementById('tStart').addEventListener('input',updatePreview);
document.getElementById('tEnd').addEventListener('input',updatePreview);
document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click',doSave);
document.getElementById('delBtn').addEventListener('click',doDelete);
document.getElementById('cancelBtn').addEventListener('click',closeModal);
document.getElementById('backdrop').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(e.target===document.getElementById('backdrop'))closeModal();
});
document.getElementById('fab').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const n=new Date();
  openModal(dk(n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),n.getDate()),n.getDate(),n.getMonth(),n.getFullYear(),false,null,null);
});

render();
</script>
